column1: # MODE_TYLER scene script table -- the ONE source of truth for the spoken French (Piper, a LABELED
# STOPGAP generator, run at BUILD time in CI by render_scenes.py -- nothing rendered is committed) and
# for the HUD subtitles in SHANKPIT's tyler_*_coldopen.c (render_scenes.py fails the build if they drift).
# Columns (TAB-separated): beat, actor (tyler | hana | - for a silent subtitle-only beat), authored
# hold_ms, french (accented -- exactly what is spoken), english gloss (shown as [EN: ...]).
# Two rows with the same beat are two spoken lines in that beat, played in order with a 300 ms gap.
# "tyler"/"hana" are the scene's TWO SCRIPTED SLOTS, not necessarily those characters (see scene header).
# SCENE vh01: Tyler (slot tyler, voice fr_FR-tom) and Hana (slot hana, voice fr_FR-siwis).
